stem.en: If you ___ me earlier, I could have helped you.

why.en: An imagined past (could have helped) needs if + past perfect: if you had told me.
why.uz: Xayoliy oʻtmish (could have helped) uchun if + Past Perfect kerak: if you had told me.
why.ru: Воображаемое прошлое (could have helped) требует if + Past Perfect: if you had told me.

stem.en: We would have won the match if our best player ___ injured.

why.en: With would have in the result, the if-part uses the past perfect: hadn't been.
why.uz: Natija qismida would have boʻlsa, if qismi Past Perfect da: hadn't been.
why.ru: Если в результате would have, то в части с if — Past Perfect: hadn't been.

stem.en: If she had left home on time, she ___ the bus.

why.en: If + past perfect about the past takes would have + past participle: wouldn't have missed.
why.uz: Oʻtmish haqidagi if + Past Perfect dan keyin would have + uchinchi shakl: wouldn't have missed.
why.ru: После if + Past Perfect о прошлом — would have + третья форма: wouldn't have missed.

options.en: I'd have come if you'd invited me.
I had come if you would invite me.
I'd have come if you'd have invite me.
I'll have come if you'd invited me.

why.en: Third conditional: would have + past participle (I'd have come) and if + past perfect (you'd invited).
why.uz: Uchinchi tur shart gap: would have + uchinchi shakl (I'd have come) va if + Past Perfect (you'd invited).
why.ru: Условное третьего типа: would have + третья форма (I'd have come) и if + Past Perfect (you'd invited).

stem.en: I wish I ___ taller. Then I could play basketball better.

why.en: A wish about the present uses a past form; with be, were is the standard choice.
why.uz: Hozirgi istak oʻtgan zamon shakli bilan ifodalanadi; be uchun odatda were ishlatiladi.
why.ru: Желание о настоящем выражается формой прошедшего; для be обычно were.

stem.en: I wish I ___ so much money on clothes last month.

why.en: Regret about the past (last month) uses wish + past perfect: hadn't spent.
why.uz: Oʻtmishdagi (last month) afsus wish + Past Perfect bilan: hadn't spent.
why.ru: Сожаление о прошлом (last month): wish + Past Perfect: hadn't spent.

stem.en: If only we ___ a car! Then we wouldn't have to walk.

why.en: If only about the present works like wish: it takes the past simple (had).
why.uz: Hozirgi holat haqidagi If only wish kabi ishlaydi: Past Simple (had) bilan keladi.
why.ru: If only о настоящем работает как wish: с Past Simple (had).

why.uz: Hozirgi qobiliyat haqidagi istakda can ning oʻtgan shakli could ishlatiladi.
why.ru: Желание об умении сейчас выражается could — прошедшей формой can.

stem.en: The lights are off. They ___ gone to bed already.

why.en: We are almost sure about a past action from the evidence: must have + past participle.
why.uz: Dalilga qarab oʻtgan harakatga deyarli ishonamiz: must have + uchinchi shakl.
why.ru: По фактам мы почти уверены в прошлом действии: must have + третья форма.

stem.en: Aziz ___ seen me at the market. He didn't say hello.

why.en: We are sure something did not happen in the past: can't have + past participle.
why.uz: Oʻtmishda biror narsa sodir boʻlmaganiga ishonchimiz komil: can't have + uchinchi shakl.
why.ru: Мы уверены, что в прошлом этого не было: can't have + третья форма.

stem.en: I'm not sure why she's late. She ___ missed the bus.

why.en: A possible past explanation: might have + past participle (might have missed).
why.uz: Oʻtmishdagi ehtimoliy sabab: might have + uchinchi shakl (might have missed).
why.ru: Возможное объяснение в прошлом: might have + третья форма (might have missed).

stem.en: You ___ left your phone at school. I saw you using it on the bus.

why.en: It is impossible that this happened, so we use can't have + past participle.
why.uz: Bu sodir boʻlgan boʻlishi mumkin emas, shuning uchun can't have + uchinchi shakl.
why.ru: Это невозможно, поэтому can't have + третья форма.

stem.en: The road ___ at the moment, so we have to take another way.

why.en: Someone is repairing the road now: present continuous passive, is being + past participle.
why.uz: Yoʻlni hozir kimdir taʼmirlayapti: Present Continuous majhul nisbati, is being + uchinchi shakl.
why.ru: Дорогу сейчас ремонтируют: пассив Present Continuous, is being + третья форма.

stem.en: I hate ___ what to do all the time.

why.en: Other people tell me, so after hate we need the passive -ing form: being told.
why.uz: Menga boshqalar aytadi, shuning uchun hate dan keyin majhul -ing shakli: being told.
why.ru: Мне говорят другие, поэтому после hate нужна пассивная форма на -ing: being told.

why.en: Results do not announce anything; someone announces them: will be + past participle.

why.ru: Результаты сами ничего не объявляют, их объявляют: will be + третья форма.

stem.en: Nobody has cleaned this room for weeks. → This room ___ for weeks.

why.en: The present perfect passive is has been + past participle; in the negative, hasn't been cleaned.
why.uz: Present Perfect majhul nisbati: has been + uchinchi shakl; inkorda hasn't been cleaned.
why.ru: Пассив Present Perfect: has been + третья форма; в отрицании hasn't been cleaned.
